draft.emotion: straightforward and polite, signaling readiness to listen or respond
notes: With close friends or family, use うん (un) instead, as はい sounds polite or formal.
When answering a negative question, はい agrees with the negative statement (e.g., 'Didn't you go?' — 'はい (No, I didn't)').
